description: Source code for DHCP client control functions, including enabling/disabling DHCPv4 and DHCPv6, and managing neighbor discovery.

methods.name: dhcpc4_enable
methods.description: Enables DHCPv4 client on specified interface.

methods.name: dhcpc4_disable
methods.description: Disables DHCPv4 client on specified interface.

methods.name: dhcp4_layer
methods.description: Controls DHCPv4 layer, enabling or disabling based on parameter.

methods.name: dhcpc6_enable
methods.description: Enables DHCPv6 client and neighbor discovery on specified interface.

methods.name: dhcpc6_disable
methods.description: Disables DHCPv6 client and neighbor discovery on specified interface.

methods.name: dhcp6_layer
methods.description: Controls DHCPv6 layer, enabling or disabling based on parameter.
